title: unarmed essentials
description: Unarmed Essential's is a fair optimization/essential mod pack that not only enhances FPS but it also includes mods that make your Minecraft experience better
body:
Unarmed Essentials is a lightweight optimization and utility mod pack that boosts FPS and improves overall gameplay. It features helpful quality-of-life mods that make Minecraft smoother and easier to play, without giving any unfair advantage. Perfect for both singleplayer and multiplayer, it keeps things balanced while enhancing your experience.
At its core, Unarmed Essentials focuses on boosting FPS and overall game stability, making it an ideal choice for players with low to mid-end systems or anyone looking for a smoother experience. The mod pack includes powerful optimization tools that reduce lag, improve frame rates, and ensure consistent performance even in demanding environments.
